dlg.lena.convoy.start: You said the convoy was irregular. What changed?
dlg.lena.convoy.route: The route was corrected after departure. I want to know why.
dlg.lena.convoy.end: Keep your eyes open. Something is wrong with the record.
dlg.tidari.registry.start: There is an amendment, but its origin is not in the ordinary registry chain.
dlg.tidari.registry.reported: I will attach your report to the registry discrepancy.
dlg.tidari.registry.withheld: Then keep the discrepancy private. It may matter later.
dlg.nova.anomaly.start: The scan shows a pattern I have seen before.
dlg.nova.anomaly.scan: The timing and structure match the route amendment.
dlg.nova.compare.start: Put the two records beside each other.
dlg.nova.compare.result: Two independent sources carry the same pattern. That is not an explanation. It is a lead.
dlg.nova.sigma.start: The pattern is reacting to the resonance.
dlg.nova.sigma.signal: Something answered. I cannot tell you what it is yet.
